subject: Refund request after outage
body: Hi Loopwire team, The service was down for most of Tuesday and we would like that day refunded as your SLA promises. Our account manager said to send the request here. We are on the Pro plan. Our admin is on leave this week so I am writing instead. Thanks, Lena

subject: Could you add a Slack digest?
body: Hi Loopwire team, It would help us a lot if the weekly summary could be posted to a Slack channel instead of only email. Right now someone copies it over by hand. Account type: team. We have been customers since 2024. Thanks, Noor

subject: Invoice for September looks wrong
body: Hi Loopwire team, The invoice we received this morning shows 14 seats but we only have 11 active users. Could you reissue it with the correct seat count and our VAT id, DE811223344? We have an Enterprise agreement with you. Let me know if you need anything else from us. Thanks, Noor

subject: Cancel the subscription
body: Hi Loopwire team, The team that used this has been disbanded and nobody is using it any more, so please cancel our subscription. There is nothing wrong with the product. We have not upgraded from the free tier yet. Our admin is on leave this week so I am writing instead. Thanks, Noor

subject: Stop the renewal
body: Hi Loopwire team, Our contract renews on the 1st and we do not want it to; please stop the auto-renewal. We may come back next year. We have been customers since 2024. We are a Team plan customer. Thanks, Jonas

subject: Receipt needed for last payment
body: Hi Loopwire team, Our finance team needs a proper receipt for the payment that went through on the 3rd. The card statement just says LOOPWIRE and they will not accept that. We are on the Pro plan. We have been customers since 2024. Thanks, Priya

subject: Close our account at the end of the month
body: Hi Loopwire team, We are consolidating tools and will not be renewing, so please close our account when the current period ends. We would like an export of our data before that. We pay for Pro monthly. We have been customers since 2024. Thanks, Mira

subject: Timezone wrong in the activity chart
body: Hi Loopwire team, The activity chart is shifted by two hours for our whole team since the clocks changed. Our workspace timezone is set correctly. We are based in Berlin if that matters for time zones. Plan: Enterprise. Thanks, Aisha

subject: Dark mode for the dashboard
body: Hi Loopwire team, Half the office runs dark themes everywhere and the dashboard is the one bright window left. A dark theme would be very welcome. Thanks for the quick help last time, by the way. We are on the free plan. Thanks, Jonas

subject: Request: custom fields on teams
body: Hi Loopwire team, We would like to tag teams with a cost centre so the reports can be grouped by it. Is that something you are considering? Sorry if this is the wrong place to ask. We are on the Enterprise plan. Thanks, Mira

subject: Please refund the duplicate charge
body: Hi Loopwire team, We were charged twice on the 12th, once for 240 and once for 240 again, and I would like the second one refunded. The bank reference for the duplicate is LW-88213. Our admin is on leave this week so I am writing instead. We have not upgraded from the free tier yet. Thanks, Lena

subject: Export produces an empty CSV
body: Hi Loopwire team, Exporting the weekly report gives a CSV with only the header row, no data. The same report renders fine on screen. We have been customers since 2024. We have not upgraded from the free tier yet. Thanks, Tomas

subject: API endpoint for sensor data
body: Hi Loopwire team, We want to pull the raw sensor readings into our own warehouse and there is no endpoint for that today. Even a nightly export would do. We pay for Pro monthly. We are based in Berlin if that matters for time zones. Thanks, Tomas

subject: Locked out after phone change
body: Hi Loopwire team, I got a new phone and my two-factor codes no longer work, so I cannot get into my account at all. I do not have the backup codes anywhere. Sorry if this is the wrong place to ask. Plan: Free. Thanks, Tomas

subject: API key leaked in a public repo
body: Hi Loopwire team, One of our developers accidentally committed our API key to a public repository. Please revoke it and tell us what it was used for. Account type: team. Our admin is on leave this week so I am writing instead. Thanks, Jonas

subject: SSO login loops back to the sign-in page
body: Hi Loopwire team, Since this morning our Okta sign-in just sends everyone back to the login page without an error. Nothing changed on our side as far as we know. I have attached a screenshot. Account type: team. Thanks, Noor

subject: Cannot sign in on the desktop app
body: Hi Loopwire team, The web app works but the desktop app rejects my credentials every time. I have reinstalled it once already. We are based in Berlin if that matters for time zones. We have an Enterprise agreement with you. Thanks, Mira

subject: Wrong delivery address on the kit
body: Hi Loopwire team, The kit is on its way to our old office; we moved last month and I need the delivery redirected. The courier says only the sender can change the address. I am writing from my personal email because the work one is down. We are on the free plan. Thanks, Priya

subject: Possible vulnerability in the share links
body: Hi Loopwire team, I noticed that report share links can be guessed by incrementing the id, which looks like an access control gap. Happy to walk your team through it. Thanks for the quick help last time, by the way. We pay for Pro monthly. Thanks, Hana

subject: Customs hold on our kit
body: Hi Loopwire team, The sensor kit shipment is being held at customs in Zurich and they are asking for a commercial invoice from you. Can you send one so it gets released? Account type: pro. Let me know if you need anything else from us. Thanks, Hana

subject: Kit arrived with a cracked housing
body: Hi Loopwire team, The sensor kit was delivered today and two of the sensors have cracked housings from the transit. The outer box was also crushed on one corner. We are a Team plan customer. Our admin is on leave this week so I am writing instead. Thanks, Tomas

subject: Suspicious login from another country
body: Hi Loopwire team, I received an alert about a sign-in to my account from a city I have never been to. I have changed my password but want you to check what was accessed. We are based in Berlin if that matters for time zones. Plan: Free. Thanks, Tomas

subject: Money back for unused seats
body: Hi Loopwire team, We paid for a year up front and then shrank the team, so I am asking for a refund on the six seats nobody used. Happy to provide the usage export if that helps. I am writing from my personal email because the work one is down. Plan: Team. Thanks, Hana

subject: Sensor kit has not arrived
body: Hi Loopwire team, We ordered the desk sensor kit three weeks ago and the tracking page has not updated since it left the warehouse. The order number is LW-ORD-5521. Plan: Enterprise. Sorry if this is the wrong place to ask. Thanks, Tomas

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: Hi Loopwire team, I have requested a password reset four times and nothing shows up, not even in spam. Other emails from you reach me fine. We are on the Pro plan. Sorry if this is the wrong place to ask. Thanks, Noor

subject: Return the sensor kit and refund it
body: Hi Loopwire team, The sensor kit turned out to be the wrong fit for our office, so I want to send it back and get the purchase refunded. It is unopened and still in the original box. I am writing from my personal email because the work one is down. We are on the Enterprise plan. Thanks, Priya

subject: Notifications fire twice
body: Hi Loopwire team, Every alert now arrives twice, once by email and once again a minute later. It started about a week ago. I am writing from my personal email because the work one is down. We are a Team plan customer. Thanks, Aisha

subject: Charged in USD instead of EUR
body: Hi Loopwire team, We were charged in dollars this month even though our account is set to euros. The amount is right, it is only the currency that changed, and it makes reconciliation painful. Account type: free. I am writing from my personal email because the work one is down. Thanks, Tomas

subject: Dashboard shows an error on load
body: Hi Loopwire team, Since the update yesterday the team dashboard shows 'Something went wrong (code 500)' every time we open it. It happens in Chrome and Safari for everyone on the team. We are on the Pro plan. Sorry if this is the wrong place to ask. Thanks, Diego

subject: Question about proration
body: Hi Loopwire team, We added three people mid-month and I want to understand how the prorated line on the invoice was calculated. It does not match what the pricing page suggested. Our admin is on leave this week so I am writing instead. We are a Team plan customer. Thanks, Aisha

subject: Phishing email impersonating you
body: Hi Loopwire team, Several of our staff got an email pretending to be from your billing team with a link to a fake login page. I have attached the headers. Account type: enterprise. Let me know if you need anything else from us. Thanks, Tomas

subject: Downgrading to closing the account
body: Hi Loopwire team, We tried the smaller plan for a month and it is not worth keeping, so please close the account entirely. Confirm once it is done. Sorry if this is the wrong place to ask. We are on the Enterprise plan. Thanks, Jonas
